Little India

Little India

Little India 5

  1. Must see · Chilli Crab & Seafood · Little India

    Muthu's Curry

    Pioneered South-Indian fish head curry (1969); Michelin Bib Gourmand, the local go-to.

    138 Race Course Road, Little India

    Recommended by MICHELIN Guide, HungryGoWhere, Miss Tam Chiak (misstamchiak.com)

  2. Worth the detour · Little India

    Sri Veeramakaliamman Temple

    Little India's landmark Hindu temple to the goddess Kali, founded by Tamil lime-kiln workers (1855).

    Look for Temple

    141 Serangoon Road, Little India

    Recommended by Roots.gov.sg (National Heritage Board), Wikipedia (English)

  3. Worth the detour · Little India

    Former House of Tan Teng Niah

    The last surviving Chinese villa in Little India (1900), painted in vivid rainbow colours.

    Look for Heritage

    37 Kerbau Road, Little India

    Recommended by Visit Singapore (Singapore Tourism Board), Wikipedia (English)

  4. Worth the detour · Indian & Roti Prata · Little India

    Allauddin's Briyani

    Tekka's most popular biryani stall since 1968; Michelin-recognised.

    #01-232 Tekka Centre, 665 Buffalo Road, Little India

    Recommended by The Honeycombers Singapore, MICHELIN Guide

  5. Deep cut · Indian & Roti Prata · Little India

    Komala Vilas

    Heritage vegetarian South Indian since 1947; the gold standard for masala thosai.

    76-78 Serangoon Road, Little India

    Recommended by Seth Lui, Visit Singapore (Singapore Tourism Board)

How this guide was made
